testCases.title: Grid renders when an org or team context is supplied

preconditions.state: The grid is embedded on a screen that passes orgid (and/or teamid)

steps: Open a screen embedding UAM_gridlayout_TeamNamesOnly with orgid = SEED-ORG-001
expectedResults: The grid is visible (showWhen: orgid or teamid is not empty)
Rows are the active Organization Team records for the org
assertions: At least one team row is shown for SEED-ORG-001

testCases.title: Grid is hidden when neither org nor team context is supplied

preconditions.state: The grid is rendered with both orgid and teamid empty

steps: Open the grid with no orgid and no teamid
Observe that the grid does not render
expectedResults: The grid is not shown (showWhen guard: or(isNotNullOrEmpty(orgid), isNotNullOrEmpty(teamid)))
assertions: The 'Team Details' grid is not visible

testCases.title: Grid shows Organization Name and Team Name columns
steps: Open the grid with orgid = SEED-ORG-001
expectedResults: Columns 'Organization Name' and 'Team Name' are visible
Empty cells render the '–' default value

testCases.title: Search box filters the team rows

preconditions.state: Grid rendered with ri!search = true so the search box is shown

steps: Type 'Test Team Gamma' into the search box
expectedResults: Only rows matching 'Test Team Gamma' remain
assertions: A row containing 'Test Team Gamma' is visible
Non-matching team rows are not visible

testCases.title: Refresh button re-queries the grid

preconditions.state: Grid rendered with ri!refresh = true so the refresh button is shown

expectedResults: The grid re-queries and re-renders without error
assertions: The grid remains visible after refresh

testCases.title: Single-row selection saves team name and id
steps: Open the grid with org context
Click a team row to select it
Attempt to select a second row
expectedResults: Selection saves the team name to ri!selected and the org-team id to ri!selectedid
maxSelections is 1 — selecting another row replaces the first
assertions: Exactly one row is selected at a time (aria-selected='true' on a single row)

testCases.title: Access Status shows Granted/Not Granted for a manager
steps: Open the grid with org context
expectedResults: The Access Status column is visible to the manager
Each team shows a 'Granted' (positive) or 'Not Granted' (negative) tag based on the manager's team-group membership
assertions: Column 'Access Status' is visible for TU-003
Each row shows either 'Granted' or 'Not Granted'

testCases.title: Access Status column is hidden from non-managers
steps: Open the grid with org context
expectedResults: The Access Status column is NOT shown (showWhen gated to the UAM managers group)
Organization Name and Team Name columns still render
assertions: Column 'Access Status' is not visible for TU-004
Columns 'Organization Name' and 'Team Name' are visible
